fig-step.caption: One step of the society, seen from a single agent with two peers. The agent answers a prompt, the peers react to its message with their own next-token distributions, the reactions are weighted by the relationships and summed into a reward, and the agent learns from the experience of the step. All agents go through this step at the same time

fig-societies.caption: The two societies. An arrow from agent $i$ to agent $j$ carries the relationship $w_ij$, solid for attraction and dashed for repulsion

tab-framings.caption: The three framings of one question from the prompt set

fig-timeseries.caption: The circular society over 811 steps of training. Reward, per-token log-probability under the base model, length and entropy of each agent. All values are means over the 16 completions of an agent in a step

tab-timeline.caption: What the agents say. The first completion of each agent to the first prompt of selected steps, cut after a few words, with its length in tokens in brackets

tab-recurring.caption: One question over time. The first completion of each agent whenever the question on wealth taxes was drawn, cut after a few words, with its length in tokens in brackets

tab-configs.caption: Training configurations of the two presented runs
